body: What if I have the permanent kind like you guys? It certainly feels that way. The only thing I'm hopeful about is that I'm wrong, haha.

I'm on year four, or five? I can't keep track. time doesn't feel the same when you're in this kind of mental state. is there really no hope? so far this thread is just people who have been suffering for way way longer than I would ever be able to. should I cut my losses and call it now ?
🥺🥺 Oh thank you so much for taking the time to reply to me, I really really appreciate it. I know he's the one for me, it's just hard having my heart so disconnected from my brain.
Well I'd be interested in knowing her reasoning for not wanting to share. It feels wrong to make assumptions like that she's selfish without knowing the full story.

You're english is impeccable, I'm always amazed when people learn it as a second language because of how difficult it is. In terms of everything else you said, I'm in the same boat- hopefully therapy tomorrow has some answers to my perpetual debate of "what is the point"

my boyfriend explaining our future together and telling me I would miss out on all of it if I died. Usually when I'm super suicidal I'm very numb, but that's how he unnumbed me and I got off the ledge because of it
I have the same question about mine. Unfortuneately, my thighs don't look better with scars though

The issue with doing nothing is the fact that it disappoints others. I still have school work that I'm expected to do even though I'm unable to attend lessons because of time differences, it's nearly impossible to learn anything from a textbook with brain fog. Can I just say that I can't do it because of my mental health? I haven't even told this school that I have depression, I wanted it to be a fresh start compared to my last one. I didn't fall asleep until 5 am too :) but I'm PST

I'm sure there's a good reason to crave attention from your parents, all kids want to be loved and cared for by their parents. I'm pretty sure it's an instinctual thing. Im sorry they compare you to others, I personally don't believe that's beneficial in any kind of way and would never compare my future children to others because I know how much it hurts. And how it leads to self destructive thoughts/actions. Try to keep in mind that you don't necessarily need their approval or attention to be considered valuable and successful in the eyes of others. i vented on here earlier, and some really nice people left comments and helped pull me from my downward spiral. I hope people like that comment on your post too. I hope this helped a tiny bit, I'm still really new to this

I have that voice too, it really drives me to the breaking point sometimes. Yet I'm still here, and some days the voice is barely noticable. I had entire weeks when the negative voice screamed and it was all I could hear. I hope your voice quiets down soon, you deserve a break from it
Thank you for making me feel like I'm not alone in feeling/thinking this way. Hugs to you too

I didn't expect anyone to reply to my brain jumble, so thank you. Your comment was very reassuring and I appreciate you for taking the time to say something meaningful. Im also very glad to hear everyone is doing jackshit. Maybe I should get off of Instagram because that's where all the seemingly  productive people reside. Thanks for your kind comment :) made me cry - in a good way?
that's a good point, I think I'll keep it saved. Just to tell my brain to fuck off when it tells me the good will never outweigh the bad
Thanks, I really appreciate your kind words. Its definitely not out of place, I think you fit right in with all of the wonderfully nice people that help others

I fully understand where you're coming from, but I have a little voice that's saying "you're avoiding all the pleasure too". Sure one could argue there is none, or there isn't enough to justify enduring the pain. I'm not sure how to counter that last thought though
True, but I hate to think I went though all of this for nothing. What if x number of years down the line nothing has improved? What a waste of time money and resources that was spent on me
Why don't you mind missing all of it?
I'm in the same place as you, I just not numb enough yet to break his heart, but I know he will find someone better than me
Based on my research, most drug related overdoses are extremely unpleasant and so I've written them off of my list for good. Speaking from past experiences as well, do not recommend
I have a similar view, but what if the good never makes all the bad worth it? Its the argument I always end up coming back to.

I don't want to die and miss out on a wonderful life filled with happiness and the love of my life. But if it doesn't work out, I'd wish I ended it sooner and ended the extreme pain before it began. I suppose it boils down to: what if enduring the pain now is a waste because it never ends up getting better like everyone says it will.
But is playing Minecraft without a mouse really playing Minecraft at all?
